title: Blast Isles
hook: Take turns lobbing shells across the islands: a blast throws round critters tumbling through the air, into each other and into the sea.
prompt: a turn-based artillery party game with round cartoon critters on little islands in the sea: aim, set the power, mind the wind, and blast your friends flying into the water

controls.primary: hold to charge the power, release to fire where you look

round.winBy: first to 6 points, or most points when time is up: a friend your blast throws scores 1, a friend who lands in the sea scores 3

world.notes: Three grassy islands in a sea, cliffs with the soil showing. Craters undermine the ground; what they leave hanging falls.

mechanics.as: aim with the view, charge the power, mind the wind; weapons on a wheel
blasts throw critters tumbling, bouncing and into each other
every blast bites a crater; ground left hanging falls
a critter in the sea is out for a moment, then back on dry ground

rules.summary: Players take turns. On your turn look where you want the shot to go, hold primary to charge the power and let go to fire; the wind blows it sideways. A blast throws every critter near it flying: one you throw scores 1, one that lands in the sea scores 3, and it comes back on its island a moment later. First to 6 points wins.
rules.scoring: +1 per friend your blast throws, +3 when a friend you threw lands in the sea

characters.describe: a round jelly critter with big eyes; each friend a different colour

sounds.describe: a critter falling into the sea, a big splash

accept: friends take turns and see each other's shots fly, the camera following the shot
a blast throws a critter flying, tumbling and bouncing, the same flight on both screens
a critter thrown into the sea splashes, is out for a moment and comes back on dry ground

content.notes: Cartoon blasts: critters get thrown about and splash into the sea, nobody is hurt.
